title: AdvancedTeleporters
description: This is a better Teleporter Mod.
body:
# How to Use
Advanced Teleporter is useful teleporter.
Where to teleport depends on Two Blocks under Advanced Teleporter.
When you stand on the teleporter, it teleports you on the other one whose two blocks are same ones.
![How to Use](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/67bd1fd7438cb97652dfadb7b00ca2594685f114.png)
